content:
maddie: Quick heads-up — interview with HarborLine wrapped. They gave a tight hero line and want a short embargo until 2026-04-05 08:00 PDT. Need signed permission + legal quick-check for any comparative claims.

ryan: Hero candidate: "Redwood let us standardize inference across teams and cut average latency variability in half." Thoughts?

noah: Nice. I'll draft a 2-sentence teaser + long form and prepare 2 social variants. Planning to include a 30s clip.

olga: Legal: please attach transcript + proposed attribution (name/title). If we say "in half" we need the baseline timeframe (e.g., 90-day avg) or change to "~50%". Also require a signed permissions PDF for logo/headshot. 24h turnaround if docs arrive today.

upload-bot: Transcript uploaded: /recordings/harborline-2026-03-24/transcript.v1.txt

ryan: Attribution: "Samir Patel, VP Engineering, HarborLine". They don't want email public. I'll get the permission PDF signed today.

jia: Lead routing plan: case study page form -> set property `cs_source:harborline` -> add to list `webinar-invite-harborline` -> tag high-intent `cs:harborline-hot` if they click RSVP -> route to SF queue "CS - HarborLine". Will add utm_campaign=cs_harborline_apr.

noah: Also propose A/B test two hero lines for first 48h: (A) technical (above), (B) impact: "Engineers stopped firefighting infra and built product instead."

olga: Embargo noted. Please put exact lift timestamp in the permission doc so contract references it. I'll redline once permission is uploaded.

ryan: Permission PDF uploaded: /permissions/harborline/permission-signed-2026-03-24.pdf

olga: Got it. Running a quick review now; will flag if we need to soften numeric language to "~50%".

jia: I'll spin up the HubSpot workflow today and add the hidden utm and cookie expiry 30d. Also create SF queue and short SDR playbook.

maddie: Action items:
- ryan: signed permission (done)
- noah: draft assets + drop drive link (EOD Thu)
- olga: legal redline + clearance (Mon)
- jia: HubSpot workflow + SF routing (this week)

maddie: tagging @here for visibility :sparkles:

upload-bot: Note: raw audio retained 90 days per policy.
